channel.title: SSbreakingHeadlines
channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Trump Calls Iran Conflict 'Minor' for U.S.
item.description: President Trump minimized the conflict with Iran and defended Vice President JD Vance's remarks that it was not a war.

item.title: Federal judge extends injunction against new USPS mail ballot rules
item.description: The judge overseeing the dispute over new U.S. Postal Service mail ballot rules has extended her injunction for the November midterms.

item.title: WATCH: 9/11 statue moved to Pennsylvania park ahead of 25th anniversary
item.description: The 6,700-pound sculpture shows hands holding up a beam from the World Trade Center.

item.title: ICE whistleblower claims agency bypassed vetting for new hires
item.description: An official responsible for overseeing ICE recruit vetting alleged that the agency was cutting corners in the process, according to a whistleblower complaint.
